title: Something is jamming GPS over Europe. Here's what we found
speaker: Veritasium
zh: 【Veritasium】歐洲上空的 GPS 受到幹擾。這是我們發現的（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: In November 2024, Professor Todd Humphreys, a GPS expert at the University of Texas at Austin,
cues.en: In November 2024, Professor Todd Humphreys, a GPS expert at the University of Texas at Austin,
cues.zh: 2024 年 11 月，德州大學奧斯汀分校 GPS 專家 Todd Humphreys 教授，

cues.text: got a mysterious tip-off.
cues.en: got a mysterious tip-off.
cues.zh: 得到一個神秘的密報。

cues.text: Look at two specific days, at exact times in a data set collected years earlier
cues.en: Look at two specific days, at exact times in a data set collected years earlier
cues.zh: 檢視幾年前收集的資料集中的兩個特定日期的確切時間

cues.text: by a network of GPS monitoring stations.
cues.en: by a network of GPS monitoring stations.
cues.zh: 透過 GPS 監測站網路。

cues.text: These stations continuously record signals from satellite navigation systems,
cues.en: These stations continuously record signals from satellite navigation systems,
cues.zh: 這些站不斷記錄來自衛星導航系統的訊號，

cues.text: measuring how strong they are relative to background noise.
cues.en: measuring how strong they are relative to background noise.
cues.zh: 測量它們相對於背景噪音的強度。

cues.text: It didn't seem promising.
cues.en: It didn't seem promising.
cues.zh: 看起來前景並不樂觀。

cues.text: The data was from 2021, and it was publicly available online.
cues.en: The data was from 2021, and it was publicly available online.
cues.zh: 該資料來自 2021 年，並可在網路上公開取得。

cues.text: So surely if something unusual was in there, someone would have already found it.
cues.en: So surely if something unusual was in there, someone would have already found it.
cues.zh: 所以如果裡面有什麼不尋常的東西，一定有人已經發現了。

cues.text: But Professor Humphreys and his student Zach Clements looked into the data at the two specific times suggested,
cues.en: But Professor Humphreys and his student Zach Clements looked into the data at the two specific times suggested,
cues.zh: 但漢弗萊斯教授和他的學生扎克·克萊門茨在建議的兩個特定時間研究了資料，

cues.text: and they discovered something surprising.
cues.en: and they discovered something surprising.
cues.zh: 他們發現了一些令人驚訝的事情。

cues.text: At one precise moment, receivers across the network all reported the same thing,
cues.en: At one precise moment, receivers across the network all reported the same thing,
cues.zh: 在某一特定時刻，網路上的接收者都報告了同樣的事情，

cues.text: a sudden drop in signal-to-noise ratio.
cues.en: a sudden drop in signal-to-noise ratio.
cues.zh: 訊雜比突然下降。

cues.text: In effect, the navigation signals had been overwhelmed.
cues.en: In effect, the navigation signals had been overwhelmed.
cues.zh: 實際上，導航訊號已經被淹沒。

cues.text: The measured signal-to-noise dropped by roughly a factor of 10.
cues.en: The measured signal-to-noise dropped by roughly a factor of 10.
cues.zh: 測得的訊雜比下降了大約 10 倍。

cues.text: But when they started looking back through the data, they found 75 days since 2019
cues.en: But when they started looking back through the data, they found 75 days since 2019
cues.zh: 但當他們開始回顧資料時，他們發現自 2019 年以來已經 75 天了

cues.text: where these strong disruptions had taken place.
cues.en: where these strong disruptions had taken place.
cues.zh: 這些強烈的破壞發生的地方。

cues.text: And again, and again, the pattern was the same.
cues.en: And again, and again, the pattern was the same.
cues.zh: 一次又一次，模式都是一樣的。

cues.text: All these receivers recorded the same drop at the same time.
cues.en: All these receivers recorded the same drop at the same time.
cues.zh: 所有這些接收器同時記錄到相同的下降。

cues.text: This effect was being felt all the way across Europe,
cues.en: This effect was being felt all the way across Europe,
cues.zh: 整個歐洲都感受到了這種影響

cues.text: all the way to the north, to Svalbard, to the south, to Spain, all the way to Canada in the west,
cues.en: all the way to the north, to Svalbard, to the south, to Spain, all the way to Canada in the west,
cues.zh: 一路向北，到斯瓦爾巴群島，向南，到西班牙，一直到西部的加拿大，

cues.text: as far east as eastern Poland.
cues.en: as far east as eastern Poland.
cues.zh: 遠至波蘭東部。

cues.text: And in fact, it had a distinct pattern across Europe to where it looked
cues.en: And in fact, it had a distinct pattern across Europe to where it looked
cues.zh: 事實上，它在整個歐洲都有一個獨特的模式

cues.text: like the blast center was in Poland or Kaliningrad in that area.
cues.en: like the blast center was in Poland or Kaliningrad in that area.
cues.zh: 就像爆炸中心在波蘭或加里寧格勒那個地區。

cues.text: So, they wondered what could cause this.
cues.en: So, they wondered what could cause this.
cues.zh: 因此，他們想知道是什麼導致了這種情況。

cues.text: At first, they thought perhaps it's interference, something on the ground broadcasting a much stronger signal,
cues.en: At first, they thought perhaps it's interference, something on the ground broadcasting a much stronger signal,
cues.zh: 起初，他們認為這可能是乾擾，地面上有什麼東西廣播了更強的訊號，

cues.text: drowning out the ones coming from the satellites, which made Kaliningrad an interesting candidate.
cues.en: drowning out the ones coming from the satellites, which made Kaliningrad an interesting candidate.
cues.zh: 淹沒了來自衛星的訊號，這使加里寧格勒成為一個有趣的候選人。

cues.text: It's a heavily militarized Russian exclave on the Baltic Sea wedged between Poland and Lithuania.
cues.en: It's a heavily militarized Russian exclave on the Baltic Sea wedged between Poland and Lithuania.
cues.zh: 這是位於波羅的海的一塊高度軍事化的俄羅斯飛地，夾在波蘭和立陶宛之間。

cues.text: And in recent years, it's become a hotspot for this kind of electronic warfare.
cues.en: And in recent years, it's become a hotspot for this kind of electronic warfare.
cues.zh: 近年來，它已成為此類電子戰的熱點。

cues.text: So maybe that was it, a side effect of the conflict in the region.
cues.en: So maybe that was it, a side effect of the conflict in the region.
cues.zh: 也許這就是該地區衝突的副作用。

cues.text: But they realized that explanation didn't work.
cues.en: But they realized that explanation didn't work.
cues.zh: 但他們意識到這種解釋不起作用。

cues.text: Even the highest tower in Kaliningrad only affects aviation as far as, say, Denmark.
cues.en: Even the highest tower in Kaliningrad only affects aviation as far as, say, Denmark.
cues.zh: 即使是加里寧格勒最高的塔樓也只會影響丹麥等地的航空。

cues.text: So, we had ourselves a mystery on our hands.
cues.en: So, we had ourselves a mystery on our hands.
cues.zh: 所以，我們手上有一個謎。

cues.text: We were experienced with interference that you could call local, something on a tower,
cues.en: We were experienced with interference that you could call local, something on a tower,
cues.zh: 我們經歷過幹擾，你可以稱之為本地幹擾，塔上的東西，

cues.text: something on a plane that might cover hundreds of kilometers.
cues.en: something on a plane that might cover hundreds of kilometers.
cues.zh: 飛機上可能飛行數百公里的東西。

cues.text: But this was different.
cues.en: But this was different.
cues.zh: 但這不一樣。

cues.text: This was continental scale.
cues.en: This was continental scale.
cues.zh: 這是大陸規模的。

cues.text: The researchers mapped out all the stations that were affected and asked a simple question.
cues.en: The researchers mapped out all the stations that were affected and asked a simple question.
cues.zh: 研究人員繪製了所有受影響的站點並提出了一個簡單的問題。

cues.text: What kind of source could have affected all of them at once?
cues.en: What kind of source could have affected all of them at once?
cues.zh: 什麼樣的來源可以同時影響他們所有人？

cues.text: The source on the ground just wouldn't work.
cues.en: The source on the ground just wouldn't work.
cues.zh: 地面上的源根本不起作用。

cues.text: The curvature of the earth would block the signal over these distances.
cues.en: The curvature of the earth would block the signal over these distances.
cues.zh: 地球的曲率會阻擋這些距離上的訊號。

cues.text: The only way to affect such a wide area simultaneously is
cues.en: The only way to affect such a wide area simultaneously is
cues.zh: 同時影響如此大範圍的唯一方法是

cues.text: from high above the earth.
cues.en: from high above the earth.
cues.zh: 從地球高處。

cues.text: And even using the most conservative assumptions, that the source only has to just clear the horizon
cues.en: And even using the most conservative assumptions, that the source only has to just clear the horizon
cues.zh: 即使使用最保守的假設，訊息來源只需清除地平線

cues.text: from the perspective of every station, the geometry shows it had to be
cues.en: from the perspective of every station, the geometry shows it had to be
cues.zh: 從每個站的角度來看，幾何形狀表明它必須是

cues.text: at least 1,200 kilometers up.
cues.en: at least 1,200 kilometers up.
cues.zh: 至少1,200公里以上。

cues.text: That's way higher than the International Space Station.
cues.en: That's way higher than the International Space Station.
cues.zh: 這比國際太空站高得多。

cues.text: So, what was causing this?
cues.en: So, what was causing this?
cues.zh: 那麼，是什麼造成了這種情況呢？

cues.text: Well, there is one known source of radio interference from space, which is the sun.
cues.en: Well, there is one known source of radio interference from space, which is the sun.
cues.zh: 嗯，有一個已知的太空無線電幹擾源，那就是太陽。

cues.text: In November 2025, a major solar storm disrupted GPS positioning globally
cues.en: In November 2025, a major solar storm disrupted GPS positioning globally
cues.zh: 2025 年 11 月，一場嚴重的太陽風暴擾亂了全球 GPS 定位

cues.text: for several hours.
cues.en: for several hours.
cues.zh: 幾個小時。

cues.text: So, could these interference events be caused by the sun?
cues.en: So, could these interference events be caused by the sun?
cues.zh: 那麼，這些幹擾事件是否是由太陽引起的呢？

cues.text: There were certainly question marks.
cues.en: There were certainly question marks.
cues.zh: 肯定還有問號。

cues.text: Solar interference typically builds up and fades over tens to hundreds of seconds.
cues.en: Solar interference typically builds up and fades over tens to hundreds of seconds.
cues.zh: 太陽幹擾通常會在數十到數百秒內逐漸增強和減弱。

cues.text: But these events were abrupt, short bursts of only three to five seconds.
cues.en: But these events were abrupt, short bursts of only three to five seconds.
cues.zh: 但這些事件都是突然的，只有三到五秒的短暫爆發。

cues.text: Another important clue was the frequencies that were disrupted.
cues.en: Another important clue was the frequencies that were disrupted.
cues.zh: 另一個重要線索是被幹擾的頻率。

cues.text: Solar interference typically spans a wide range of radio frequencies,
cues.en: Solar interference typically spans a wide range of radio frequencies,
cues.zh: 太陽幹擾通常跨越很寬的無線電頻率範圍，

cues.text: whereas this interference was confined to a very narrow slice, just five megahertz wide,
cues.en: whereas this interference was confined to a very narrow slice, just five megahertz wide,
cues.zh: 而這種幹擾僅限於一個非常狹窄的區域，只有五兆赫茲寬，

cues.text: centered at 1,577.5 megahertz.
cues.en: centered at 1,577.5 megahertz.
cues.zh: 中心頻率為 1,577.5 兆赫。

cues.text: That's right in the part of the spectrum used by GPS.
cues.en: That's right in the part of the spectrum used by GPS.
cues.zh: 這正是 GPS 使用的頻譜部分。

cues.text: And the final nail in the coffin is that solar radio bursts affect the entire sunlit side of the earth.
cues.en: And the final nail in the coffin is that solar radio bursts affect the entire sunlit side of the earth.
cues.zh: 棺材上的最後一根釘子是太陽射電爆發影響了地球整個陽光照射的一面。

cues.text: But what the researchers were seeing here was much more concentrated, consistently centered over Europe.
cues.en: But what the researchers were seeing here was much more concentrated, consistently centered over Europe.
cues.zh: 但研究人員在這裡看到的情況要集中得多，始終以歐洲為中心。

cues.text: So, Todd and Zach realized the only thing that could be causing this was a satellite,
cues.en: So, Todd and Zach realized the only thing that could be causing this was a satellite,
cues.zh: 所以，託德和扎剋意識到唯一可能造成這種情況的是一顆衛星，

cues.text: which left them with just one question.
cues.en: which left them with just one question.
cues.zh: 這讓他們只剩下一個問題。

cues.text: Is it intentional or is it accidental?
cues.en: Is it intentional or is it accidental?
cues.zh: 是故意的還是無意的？

cues.text: Both my student and I looked at this and said, unprecedented.
cues.en: Both my student and I looked at this and said, unprecedented.
cues.zh: 我和我的學生看到這一點都說，前所未有。

cues.text: We've never seen this before.
cues.en: We've never seen this before.
cues.zh: 我們以前從未見過這個。

cues.text: The world has never seen this before.
cues.en: The world has never seen this before.
cues.zh: 世界以前從未見過這種情況。

cues.text: This satellite seemed to be targeting GPS.
cues.en: This satellite seemed to be targeting GPS.
cues.zh: 這顆衛星似乎是瞄準 GPS 的。

cues.text: Or rather what most of us call GPS.
cues.en: Or rather what most of us call GPS.
cues.zh: 或者更確切地說，我們大多數人稱之為 GPS。

cues.text: That is just the shorthand.
cues.en: That is just the shorthand.
cues.zh: 這只是簡寫。

cues.text: GPS is the American system, but there are others, including the Russian one, the European one,
cues.en: GPS is the American system, but there are others, including the Russian one, the European one,
cues.zh: GPS是美國的系統，但還有其他的系統，包括俄羅斯的、歐洲的，

cues.text: and the Chinese one.
cues.en: and the Chinese one.
cues.zh: 還有中國的。

cues.text: And your phone is actually of these satellites to try and tell you where you are.
cues.en: And your phone is actually of these satellites to try and tell you where you are.
cues.zh: 而你的手機其實就是這些衛星的一部分，它們會試圖告訴你你在哪裡。

cues.text: These systems are known as Global Navigation Satellite Systems or GNSS.
cues.en: These systems are known as Global Navigation Satellite Systems or GNSS.
cues.zh: 這些系統稱為全球導航衛星系統或 GNSS。

cues.text: And when the U.S. military first developed the system in the 1970s,
cues.en: And when the U.S. military first developed the system in the 1970s,
cues.zh: 當美國軍方在 20 世紀 70 年代首次開發該系統時，

cues.text: they wanted to prove how well it really worked.
cues.en: they wanted to prove how well it really worked.
cues.zh: 他們想證明它確實有效。

cues.text: So, the GPS program office set itself an ambitious goal
cues.en: So, the GPS program office set itself an ambitious goal
cues.zh: 因此，GPS計畫辦公室為自己設定了一個雄心勃勃的目標

cues.text: to use GPS to drop five bombs in a row into the same hole from a moving plane.
cues.en: to use GPS to drop five bombs in a row into the same hole from a moving plane.
cues.zh: 使用 GPS 將五枚炸彈從移動的飛機上連續投進同一個洞。

cues.text: They set up a chair next to the site that the bombs are going to be going into.
cues.en: They set up a chair next to the site that the bombs are going to be going into.
cues.zh: 他們在炸彈即將進入的地點旁放了一張椅子。

cues.text: Wait, what?
cues.en: Wait, what?
cues.zh: 等等，什麼？

cues.text: If anyone doubts that we can drop the bombs in the same hole, you're welcome to go and stand right there and watch out.
cues.en: If anyone doubts that we can drop the bombs in the same hole, you're welcome to go and stand right there and watch out.
cues.zh: 如果有人懷疑我們能否把炸彈丟到同一個洞裡，歡迎你去站在那裡看著。

cues.text: So how does GPS work?
cues.en: So how does GPS work?
cues.zh: 那麼 GPS 是如何運作的呢？

cues.text: Well, think about what your phone is actually trying to do to tell you where you are.
cues.en: Well, think about what your phone is actually trying to do to tell you where you are.
cues.zh: 好吧，想想你的手機實際上是想做什麼來告訴你你在哪裡。

cues.text: It's listening to signals from satellites.
cues.en: It's listening to signals from satellites.
cues.zh: 它正在監聽來自衛星的訊號。

cues.text: And those signals can tell it two things.
cues.en: And those signals can tell it two things.
cues.zh: 這些訊號可以告訴它兩件事。

cues.text: First, the position of the satellite in space.
cues.en: First, the position of the satellite in space.
cues.zh: 首先，衛星在太空中的位置。

cues.text: And second, the exact time the signal was sent.
cues.en: And second, the exact time the signal was sent.
cues.zh: 其次，訊號傳送的確切時間。

cues.text: And then the receiver can compare that to when the signal arrives.
cues.en: And then the receiver can compare that to when the signal arrives.
cues.zh: 然後接收器可以將其與訊號到達的時間進行比較。

cues.text: And you can use that time difference, multiply it by the speed of light, and you get the distance.
cues.en: And you can use that time difference, multiply it by the speed of light, and you get the distance.
cues.zh: 你可以利用這個時間差，乘以光速，就可以得到距離。

cues.text: So, if it took the signal 0.07 seconds, that must mean you're around 21,000 kilometers away
cues.en: So, if it took the signal 0.07 seconds, that must mean you're around 21,000 kilometers away
cues.zh: 因此，如果訊號傳送時間為 0.07 秒，則表示您距離約 21,000 公里

cues.text: from the satellite.
cues.en: from the satellite.
cues.zh: 來自衛星。

cues.text: If you're only using a single satellite, that puts you somewhere on a huge sphere around it.
cues.en: If you're only using a single satellite, that puts you somewhere on a huge sphere around it.
cues.zh: 如果您只使用一顆衛星，那麼您就會位於它周圍的一個巨大球體上的某個位置。

cues.text: Now you can add a second one, and that will narrow your position down to this circle where the two spheres intersect.
cues.en: Now you can add a second one, and that will narrow your position down to this circle where the two spheres intersect.
cues.zh: 現在您可以新增第二個，這會將您的位置縮小到兩個球體相交的圓。

cues.text: If you add a third, you will narrow it down to only two possible points.
cues.en: If you add a third, you will narrow it down to only two possible points.
cues.zh: 如果新增第三個，您會將範圍縮小到只有兩個可能的點。

cues.text: And only one of these is actually on Earth's surface.
cues.en: And only one of these is actually on Earth's surface.
cues.zh: 其中只有一個實際上位於地球表面。

cues.text: So, you might think three satellites is all you need.
cues.en: So, you might think three satellites is all you need.
cues.zh: 因此，您可能認為三顆衛星就足夠了。

cues.text: We have three equations, one for each satellite, and three unknowns that are my position, x, y, and z.
cues.en: We have three equations, one for each satellite, and three unknowns that are my position, x, y, and z.
cues.zh: 我們有三個方程，每顆衛星一個，還有三個未知數，就是我的位置 x、y 和 z。

cues.text: So, on the left side, I have the geometric distance between me and each of the three satellites.
cues.en: So, on the left side, I have the geometric distance between me and each of the three satellites.
cues.zh: 所以，在左側，我有我和三顆衛星之間的幾何距離。

cues.text: And on the right side, I have the measured signal time, all multiplied by the speed of light.
cues.en: And on the right side, I have the measured signal time, all multiplied by the speed of light.
cues.zh: 在右側，我有測量的訊號時間，全部乘以光速。

cues.text: Now, satellites have atomic clocks, so their timing drifts
cues.en: Now, satellites have atomic clocks, so their timing drifts
cues.zh: 現在，衛星有原子鐘，所以它們的時間會發生漂移

cues.text: by only three seconds every million years.
cues.en: by only three seconds every million years.
cues.zh: 每百萬年僅縮短三秒。

cues.text: But my phone does not contain an atomic clock, so its clock can drift
cues.en: But my phone does not contain an atomic clock, so its clock can drift
cues.zh: 但我的手機沒有原子鐘，所以它的時鐘可能會漂移

cues.text: by that much in just a couple of days.
cues.en: by that much in just a couple of days.
cues.zh: 短短幾天內就增加了這麼多。

cues.text: And a timing error of just 100 nanoseconds throws off
cues.en: And a timing error of just 100 nanoseconds throws off
cues.zh: 計時誤差僅 100 奈秒

cues.text: your position by 30 meters.
cues.en: your position by 30 meters.
cues.zh: 距離您的位置 30 公尺。

cues.text: So, in reality, each distance is slightly wrong, which means the position you calculate is slightly off too.
cues.en: So, in reality, each distance is slightly wrong, which means the position you calculate is slightly off too.
cues.zh: 所以，實際上，每個距離都略有錯誤，這意味著您計算的位置也略有偏差。
